purpose: Frozen evidence and page contract for the August supervisor report; downstream stages may summarize only these registered readings and audited artifacts.
tokenizer_comparability_policy: Fit and report Mistral, TinyDialogues, and Qwen3-14B in separate scorer namespaces. Compare effect directions and interval support on the exact paired occurrence set where registered. Never pool or directly compare raw bits, intercepts, or coefficient magnitudes across tokenizers.

page_contract.figure_policy: Only already-audited figures whose associated claim has PRIMARY or SUPPORTING eligibility may be embedded. PENDING and EXCLUDED claims receive no inferential figure. Rendering must not fit models or generate plots.

locked_readings.text: The non-PBM contextual Mistral age slope is negative and therefore direction-consistent, but its frozen child-clustered primary 95% interval crosses zero, so confirmation was not achieved.
The 1,000-replicate child bootstrap is sensitivity evidence and must be displayed beside, never substituted for, the frozen child-clustered primary interval.
Development of utterance context gain is negative in TinyDialogues PBM, Mistral PBM, and Mistral non-PBM, contrary to the registered positive direction.
TinyDialogues, Qwen3-14B, and repeated Mistral results on the same 21 PBM children are scorer robustness analyses, not independent-sample confirmation.
Raw score magnitudes are not pooled or directly compared across Mistral, TinyDialogues, and Qwen tokenizers.
The frozen simultaneous-band rule establishes no sustained onset in either PBM discovery or non-PBM confirmation.
Exact-string response entropy is model-, prompt-, temperature-, seed-, and surface-form-dependent; it is not semantic response uncertainty.
Random, n-gram, LSTM, and unconstrained LLM candidates do not preserve the observed child's intended meaning, so they cannot support meaning-preserving choice or Pareto-optimality claims.
Corrected Bayes candidate_set_probability is normalized only over each row's available finite real/random/unigram/bigram/trigram set, not over all possible utterances.
Hall is a separate historical cross-sectional sociolinguistic snapshot. Its contrasts are descriptive, non-causal, and non-deficit; they are not a 14th longitudinal corpus or an 80th child.
The remaining-58 same-pass word confirmation is pending because the registered Mistral production has not run.
A validated downstream listener-utility outcome remains pending and is required before broad communicative-success claims.
Manual validation of the conversational-eligibility flags remains pending; the current structural audit is REVIEW, not PASS.
Semantic clustering, rarefaction, seed and prompt calibration, and a decoupled response generator remain pending.
Sustained-onset confirmation with validated morpheme, syllable, and phoneme effort controls remains pending.

claims.scientific_question: Does contextual utterance surprisal decrease with age at fixed observed word effort in the PBM discovery sample?

sample.scope: Brown, Manchester, and Providence children with real-target k3 scores and exact/top-coded word-effort cells

scorer.comparability_rule: Mistral-native bits only; do not pool with TinyDialogues or Qwen.

estimand.name: P1 contextual fixed-effort age slope
estimand.outcome: real_k3_sum_bits = -log2 p_Mistral(u|c_k3)
estimand.direction_convention: Negative means older children's observed utterances are more predictable to the scorer at the same measured word effort.

numerical_result.uncertainty_method: WLS on child-age-effort cells with covariance clustered by child

claims.required_interpretation: Report as increasing Mistral predictability or conventionality of form at fixed measured effort in the discovery sample.
claims.required_limitation: This is model-based self-information, not listener utility, Shannon information conveyed, causal optimization, or a normative efficiency optimum.

claims.scientific_question: Does the PBM fixed-effort contextual age direction repeat under TinyDialogues?

sample.scope: Exact TinyDialogues PBM real-target k3 rows in Brown, Manchester, and Providence

scorer.comparability_rule: Use sign and within-scorer interval only; raw bits are not comparable to Mistral.

estimand.name: P1 contextual fixed-effort age slope
estimand.outcome: real_k3_sum_bits = -log2 p_Tiny(u|c_k3)
estimand.direction_convention: Negative means greater TinyDialogues predictability with age at fixed word effort.

numerical_result.uncertainty_method: WLS on child-age-effort cells with covariance clustered by child

claims.required_interpretation: Use as scorer-direction robustness for the PBM association.
claims.required_limitation: The same 21 children are reused, so this is not independent confirmation; tokenizer-specific magnitudes are not pooled.

claims.scientific_question: On the exact paired PBM rows, do TinyDialogues and Mistral yield the same contextual age-slope magnitude?

sample.scope: Exact real-target k3 intersection scored by both TinyDialogues and Mistral

scorer.comparability_rule: The paired coefficient contrast is reported as calibration sensitivity; it does not make raw token-level bits commensurate.

estimand.name: paired P1 slope difference
estimand.outcome: TinyDialogues P1 age slope minus Mistral P1 age slope
estimand.formula_or_contrast: beta_age,Tiny - beta_age,Mistral on the exact paired occurrence set
estimand.direction_convention: Negative means the TinyDialogues age slope is more negative than the Mistral slope.

numerical_result.unit: bits per month on scorer-native utterance sums

claims.required_interpretation: The negative direction repeats but coefficient magnitude is scorer-calibration dependent.
claims.required_limitation: Do not interpret the numeric cross-tokenizer difference as a universal information-scale difference or independent replication.

estimand.direction_convention: Registered direction is negative; confirmation additionally requires the frozen clustered 95% interval to exclude zero.

claims.required_interpretation: Direction-consistent but not confirmed under the frozen primary clustered interval.
claims.required_limitation: The primary interval crosses zero; no sensitivity analysis may be substituted to declare confirmation.

claims.scientific_question: How does child-resampling uncertainty behave for the non-PBM contextual Mistral age slope?

sample.scope: Same non-PBM P1 child-age-effort design cells, resampled by child

scorer.comparability_rule: Same-scorer sensitivity; it supplements but does not replace the registered clustered interval.

estimand.formula_or_contrast: refit frozen P1 after resampling children with replacement
estimand.direction_convention: Negative remains direction-consistent; evidential priority stays with the clustered primary interval.

claims.required_limitation: This interval must not replace the frozen child-clustered primary interval or convert the result into confirmed evidence.

claims.scientific_question: Does k3 context support for the observed utterance increase with age in PBM discovery?

sample.scope: PBM rows with paired real-target k0 and k3 Mistral scores

estimand.name: P3 context-gain age slope
estimand.outcome: real_context_gain_k3 = k0 sum bits - k3 sum bits
estimand.direction_convention: Positive was registered as increasing contextual support; negative is contrary.

claims.required_interpretation: Report the negative slope as contrary to the registered positive developmental direction.
claims.required_limitation: Do not relabel the sign to make it confirmatory; context gain remains distinct from contextual surprisal.

claims.scientific_question: For the same lexical occurrences, do unconditional and contextual word surprisal decrease with age across three scorers?

sample.scope: Exact shared primary occurrence set for Mistral, Qwen3-14B, and TinyDialogues

scorer.model: Mistral-7B-v0.3, Qwen3-14B, and TinyDialogues fitted separately
scorer.comparability_rule: Only registered direction and within-scorer interval concordance; raw scores and coefficients are never pooled.

estimand.name: same-word k0 and k3 age effects
estimand.outcome: word surprisal at k0 and k3
estimand.formula_or_contrast: registered within-scorer word models on identical occurrence identities
controls: child and corpus structure per frozen protocol
estimand.direction_convention: Negative means the same words become more predictable with age within each scorer.

required_marker.expectation: status=PASS and three scorer reports COMPLETE_AND_AUDITED
required_marker.observed: PASS; all three scorer markers present

claims.required_interpretation: Both same-word k0 and k3 questions are direction-and-interval robust across all three scorer-specific fits.
claims.required_limitation: This is same-sample robustness on PBM children, not confirmation in the remaining 58 children and not cross-tokenizer magnitude agreement.

claims.scientific_question: At centered age, do longer word types receive more contextual support across scorers?

sample.scope: Exact shared primary word-occurrence set across three separately fit scorers

scorer.model: Mistral-7B-v0.3, Qwen3-14B, and TinyDialogues fitted separately
scorer.comparability_rule: Direction and within-scorer interval concordance only.

estimand.name: longer-word context-support association
estimand.outcome: word-level k0 minus k3 context support
estimand.direction_convention: Positive means longer word types receive more context support at centered age.

claims.required_limitation: The result is lexical/scorer-indexed and does not demonstrate listener utility or meaning-preserving optimization.

claims.scientific_question: Does word-level context gain change with age consistently across scorers?

sample.scope: Exact shared primary word-occurrence set across Mistral, Qwen3-14B, and TinyDialogues

scorer.model: Mistral-7B-v0.3, Qwen3-14B, and TinyDialogues fitted separately
scorer.comparability_rule: No pooled coefficient; classify concordance from scorer-specific signs and intervals.

estimand.name: word-level context-gain age effect
estimand.outcome: word k0 minus k3 context support
estimand.formula_or_contrast: registered age term in each scorer-specific word model
estimand.direction_convention: Two-sided; mixed signs imply scorer dependence.

claims.required_limitation: Do not collapse this mixed word-level result into the utterance-level P3 result or select a favored scorer after inspection.

claims.scientific_question: Does child word effort relative to generated expected effort change with age?

sample.scope: Child-session aggregates from 21 PBM children with response-space predictors

scorer.model: Mistral-generated exact-string response space with Mistral-derived predictors
scorer.comparability_rule: No cross-model generalization; retain self-reference and prompt dependence as limitations.

estimand.name: age association in relative word effort
estimand.outcome: child_words_minus_generated_mean
estimand.formula_or_contrast: age_months_c + response_entropy_bits_c + age_months_c:response_entropy_bits_c + generated_expected_words_c + context word count + context entropy
estimand.direction_convention: Positive means observed child word effort moves upward relative to the generated reference with age.

claims.required_interpretation: Treat as a measurement-limited association relative to a model-generated reference distribution.
claims.required_limitation: Generated expected effort may mediate contextual demand; exact-string response spaces are not semantic uncertainty and the generator/scorer are coupled.

claims.required_limitation: Treat as a result or measurement diagnostic pending semantic-entropy and decoupled-generator calibration; do not spin it as confirmation.
